item.title: PlayStation Plus November 2026 Free Games Lineup Officially Revealed
item.description: On Wednesday, Sony revealed the next batch of PlayStation Plus subscribers' free Essential games. Like most months, there's a little something for everyone on offer: Dead Island 2 , Tomb Raider 4-6 — Remastered , and Monster Train 2 will be available starting Nov. 3.

item.title: 'Harry Potter Meets Stardew Valley' Game Sets Official Release Date
item.description: Witchbrook has been one of my most anticipated games since it was first teased just about a decade ago. The magical take on Stardew Valley looks to be a new entry in the cozy life-sim genre that keeps getting more enticing with every preview developer Chucklefish gives. Now, after years of patient waiting and at least one delay, Witchbrook finally has a release date.

item.title: PlayStation Officially Reveals Gorgeous New ‘Prism’ PS5 Hardware
item.description: Sony Interactive Entertainment unveiled its new Prism Collection on Wednesday, a new line of PlayStation 5 accessories featuring transparent designs for DualSense controllers and matching console covers. The collection includes three color options: Flare Orange, Emerald Green, and Graphite Gray.

item.title: 26 Years Later, BioWare’s Most Influential RPG Is Still Shaping My Life
item.description: The game was Baldur’s Gate 2: Shadows of Amn . The T-shirt, which came with the collector’s edition, sported the game’s logo: two mirrored heads, one in light, one in darkness (the exact meaning of the image has been debated for the past 26 years, with no conclusive answer). I was the kid, of course. Soon after, I bought the game and, for the first time, immersed myself in the world of the Forgotten Realms, brought to life in digital form by BioWare. Almost three decades later, BioWare is gone . The sad news made me reflect on how Baldur’s Gate 2 and the other computer RPGs they developed between the 1990s and the early 2000s marked the trajectory of my life.

item.title: Forget 'Carrie,' Mike Flanagan Series Actor Teases Her Return in a "Future" Project
item.description: T'Nia Miller is one of the stars of Disney Plus' new Marvel Studios series VisionQuest , where she plays the AI villain Jocasta . Over the course of the series so far, Jocasta has revealed herself as a deadly entity, murdering several people as the so-called "Butcherbird Killer." But while playing a Marvel villain may be a new experience for Miller, the darker elements of her character hark back to some of her previous work in the horror genre, where she is known for her collaborations with writer and producer Mike Flanagan .

item.title: Mass Effect 5 Would Have Been The 'Ultimate Open-World Game'
item.description: Electronic Arts' closure of its legendary RPG studio BioWare has shaken the video game world . Since the announcement, gamers, fans, and developers alike have mourned the studio’s unrealized potential, especially following the recent reveal of its final project: Mass Effect Universe .

item.title: No Man’s Sky Goes Full Horror in New 'Forsaken' Update
item.description: No Man’s Sky is still going strong more than a decade after its original release, and the game’s latest big update, Forsaken , is a seasonally appropriate horror show. Hello Games just dropped the full patch notes and a trailer for the 7.10 update, which is available today.

item.title: Titan Quest 2 Is Everything The ARPG Genre Needs & More
item.description: With the 1.0 release ahead, there's no better time than now to check it out.

item.title: Marvel’s Ghost Rider Summons Heated Rivalry Star for Mystery Role
item.description: Connor Storrie has reportedly found the only role after Heated Rivalry that could possibly give him a chance to be even hotter, just in a different way. One half of the breakout leading duo from 2025's hockey romance show, Storrie may now be trading in the ice rink for the fires of hell in Marvel's upcoming Ghost Rider film .
